Hi Tom —

Thanks again for running the two-week pilot last month. The team saw the latency improvement on the embeddings-heavy pipeline and we captured token consumption across the A/B paths. I attached a short usage report and the raw latency CSV for your ops team to review (redwood-usage-report-q2.pdf, pilot-latency-summary.csv).

To prepare for your renewal window in early August, could you confirm two things:
- Expected Q4 peak TPS for inference (30-day rolling peak) — we need this to size Dedicated capacity vs burst.
- Desired SLA/latency band that would trigger moving from a flexible to a committed plan (e.g., p95 < 120ms for customer-facing requests).

I did a quick conversion ROI snapshot in the report, but high level: if ClearWave moves to a modest monthly commit (Option A in the attachment) we project ~18% cost reduction vs current burst pricing and ~24% lower per-conversation latency variance. Option B is a larger commit with burst credits that gets you to ~30% unit cost reduction and includes 48 hours of emergency burst per month.

If it helps, I can loop Ben (AE) and Grace (CS) into a short call to walk the numbers and draft a mutual action plan.

Best,
